summary: streaming phase, draft, Stop, Retry와 stale/error 상태를 HUD와 action overlay에 연결하고 동기 중복 advance를 controller 경계에서 차단했다.

stateConnections.controller: GameScreen에 유지되므로 overlay close/reopen과 무관하게 실행 상태가 보존됨

recoveryGuarantees: abortRef synchronous in-flight guard prevents two advances before React publishes running=true
Stop aborts only through the explicit control
Retry reuses the last validated preset or custom selection
failed request leaves the previous AtomicTurnSnapshot and WorldState identity unchanged
stale revision failure is shown separately from a generic network/provider failure
unmounting the overlay does not abort or retry the shared controller
prompt12Regressions: frozen request and NDJSON client state
knownLimitations: 뉴스 projection과 major-event acknowledgment는 13-24 이후 범위이므로 구현하지 않았다.
